name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clause Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) correctly captures the requirement that whenever the condition blocker_moved is true, the agent must either already have the key or eventually acquire it, which is exactly what the 'At every moment... or pick it up later' wording specifies.

texts: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.
